purpose: How footage reads native — motion, framing, audio underlay, de-shine grades

items.name: Phone-native handheld
items.framing: eye-level, imperfect center, headroom uneven OK
items.prompt_fragment: shot on phone, slight handheld micro-shake, imperfect framing, no gimbal glide, native vertical

items.name: Window / practical depth
items.lighting: real window or lamp as key; shadows exist
items.prompt_fragment: window light behind subject, practical lamp fill, visible depth, not flat gray void

items.name: Real hands + phone object
items.subject: human hands or face preferred over iconography
items.prompt_fragment: real human hands holding phone, skin texture, desk clutter OK, phone screen readable optional

items.name: Room tone under VO
items.rule: Never silent digital void under VO; ambience or licensed bed required

items.name: De-shine synthetic
items.grade: pull saturation −8, add 2% grain, slight green/magenta split avoid purple glow
when: i2v / gen footage that looks plastic

items.name: Multi-setup cuts
items.rule: Change camera setup between cuts — not the same card with new words
items.steal: Cut between person/place/product setups; one canvas fails the FB/TikTok look test
